hero.title: Is Specialty Dining Included on Oceania Cruises?
hero.subtitle: ZERO COVER CHARGES, COMPLIMENTARY SPECIALTY VENUES & RESERVATION LIMITS
hero.description: Discover which signature specialty restaurants are included in your cruise fare, how advance booking windows work by accommodation category, and which exclusive culinary experiences carry surcharges.

editorialIntro.heading: The Fine Dining Advantage: Renowned Specialty Venues Without Surcharges
paragraphs: Oceania Cruises includes its regular specialty restaurant dining in the cruise fare. Guests can enjoy restaurants such as Polo Grill, Toscana, Jacques and Red Ginger without paying a separate standard cover charge, where those venues are available on their ship.

This is one of Oceania's notable dining advantages. On some other cruise lines, specialty restaurants require an additional fee for each visit. Oceania takes a different approach by including its regular specialty restaurants as part of the onboard dining experience.

However, included dining does not mean every culinary experience is free. Premium wine-pairing dinners at La Reserve by Wine Spectator and private dining at Privée, for example, can carry additional charges. Guests should also understand that specialty dining reservations are subject to limits based on the ship, accommodation category and length of the voyage.

includedRestaurants.title: Which Specialty Restaurants Are Included on Oceania Cruises?
intro: Oceania's regular specialty restaurant lineup offers several distinct culinary styles with zero restaurant cover charges.
Availability varies by vessel, but guests can generally enjoy steakhouse, Italian, French, and contemporary Asian dining on eligible ships.

venues.title: Polo Grill – Included Classic Steakhouse
paragraphs: Polo Grill is Oceania's traditional steakhouse, serving classic American steakhouse dishes and fresh seafood in an atmosphere of rich wood paneling and leather wingback chairs.
Is Polo Grill included? Yes. Regular dining at Polo Grill is completely included in the cruise fare on ships where the venue operates (Allura, Vista, Marina, Riviera, Nautica, and Insignia).
Highlights include 28-day dry-aged USDA Prime beef, filet mignon, whole Maine lobster, oysters Rockefeller, and New York-style cheesecake.

lists.title: What You Can Order at Zero Cover Charge
items: Prime New York strip, bone-in ribeye, porterhouse, and tender filet mignon
Whole Maine lobster prepared steamed or grilled with drawn butter
Jumbo lump crab cakes, pan-seared sea scallops, and lobster bisque
Classic tableside Caesar salad and iceberg wedge with roquefort
Traditional steakhouse sides: truffle mash, creamed spinach, and grilled asparagus

venues.title: Toscana – Included Regional Italian Dining
paragraphs: Toscana celebrates the culinary traditions of Italy, with authentic family recipes originating from Tuscany, Piedmont, and the Amalfi Coast served on bespoke Versace china.
Is Toscana included? Yes. Regular dining at Toscana is fully included in the cruise fare on ships where available (Allura, Vista, Marina, Riviera, Nautica, and Insignia).
Highlights include an artisanal olive oil and balsamic cart, house-made pastas, saffron seafood risottos, and slow-braised veal shank osso buco.

lists.title: Signature Italian Courses Included
items: Custom antipasti cart featuring 24-month aged prosciutto and artisan cheeses
Handmade tortelloni with ricotta and spinach, and lobster tagliolini
Classic Osso buco alla Milanese with saffron risotto
Pan-seared Mediterranean branzino with lemon caper sauce
Traditional house-crafted tiramisu and cannoli siciliani

venues.title: Jacques – Included French Bistro by Jacques Pépin
paragraphs: Jacques is Oceania's celebrated French restaurant named after Master Chef Jacques Pépin, Oceania's founding Executive Culinary Director. The ambiance reflects a classic Parisian bistro.
Is Jacques included? Yes. There is no separate standard cover charge for regular dining at Jacques on eligible ships (Marina, Riviera, Vista, and Allura).
Highlights include traditional escargots, showpiece rotisserie meats, Dover sole filleted tableside, and warm Grand Marnier soufflés.

lists.title: French Gastronomic Classics Included
items: Escargots de Bourgogne in garlic herb butter and duck foie gras terrine
Rotisserie herb-roasted chicken and slow-roasted prime rib of beef
Classic bouillabaisse and coq au vin slow-simmered in red wine
Dover sole meunière filleted tableside with clarified brown butter
Artisanal AOC French cheese presentation and tarte tatin

venues.title: Red Ginger – Included Contemporary Asian Dining
paragraphs: Red Ginger offers contemporary interpretations of pan-Asian cuisine, blending culinary traditions from Thailand, Malaysia, Japan, and Vietnam in a striking ebony and ruby setting.
Is Red Ginger included? Yes. Regular dining at Red Ginger is included in the cruise fare where available (Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, and Sirena).
Highlights include spicy duck salad, miso-glazed sea bass wrapped in hoba leaf, aromatic Malaysian beef rendang, and artisan sushi/sashimi.

lists.title: Pan-Asian Delicacies Included
items: Signature crispy duck salad with watermelon, mint, and toasted coconut
Miso-glazed sea bass wrapped in hoba leaf (guest favorite)
Slow-cooked Malaysian beef rendang and Thai red tiger prawn curry
Freshly rolled sushi, sashimi platters, and crispy tempura
Ginger caramel cake and green tea matcha ice cream

venues.title: Tuscan Steak – Included on Oceania Sirena
paragraphs: Tuscan Steak fuses the hearty flavors of a traditional American steakhouse with rustic Tuscan touches. It serves as the signature specialty dining room aboard Oceania Sirena.
Is Tuscan Steak included? Yes. Regular dining is fully included in the cruise fare exclusively on Oceania Sirena.
Highlights include Florentine-style grilled T-bone steaks, lobster fra diavolo, veal chops alla Milanese, and house-made pasta specialties.

lists.title: Sirena Signature Highlights Included
items: Florentine-style grilled bistecca and prime aged ribeye cuts
Spicy lobster fra diavolo served over fresh egg linguine
Pan-seared veal chop Milanese and crispy pork belly
Handcrafted pasta favorites tossed in white truffle butter

reservationLimits.title: How Many Specialty Dining Reservations Can You Make?
reservationLimits.subtitle: PUBLISHED ADVANCE ALLOWANCES BY SHIP CLASS & SUITE CATEGORY
reservationLimits.intro: This is where the experience becomes more specific. Although regular specialty dining is included for all guests, Oceania limits the number of advance specialty restaurant reservations according to the ship, accommodation category and voyage length. The following reservation allowances are published by Oceania. They refer to reservations at each specialty restaurant, not the total number of specialty restaurant visits across the entire cruise.

reservationLimits.importantNote: These are the published advance reservation allowances. They do not mean guests are automatically entitled to unlimited reservations or guaranteed walk-in seating beyond their allocation. Check the current terms for your exact sailing.

bookingTimeline.title: When & How to Make Specialty Dining Reservations
bookingTimeline.subtitle: A PRACTICAL 4-PHASE GUIDE FROM ADVANCE WINDOWS TO EMBARKATION

steps.title: Phase 1: Cruise Payment in Full
steps.description: Specialty dining reservations become accessible once your cruise booking is paid in full. Ensure your account is settled before your booking tier's window opens.

steps.title: Phase 2: Advance Window Opens (by Category)
steps.description: Owner's/Vista/Oceania Suites book from final payment date (~90-150 days out); Penthouse Suites book 75 days out; Concierge Verandas book 60 days out; standard staterooms book 45 days out (all close 7 days prior to departure).

steps.title: Phase 3: Secure Reservations Online
steps.description: Log into your Oceania My Account portal to select your preferred specialty restaurants, dates, dining times, and traveling companions.

steps.title: Phase 4: Onboard Desk & Priority Embarkation
steps.description: Upon boarding, Concierge Level and Suite guests enjoy priority booking desk access from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM at Polo Grill to request second seatings or table adjustments (standard categories from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM).

multipleVisitsAndSuiteDining.title: Re-Visiting Specialty Restaurants & In-Suite Butler Dining
multipleVisitsAndSuiteDining.subtitle: HOW TO MAXIMIZE SPECIALTY MEALS ONBOARD

cards.title: Dining at the Same Specialty Venue More Than Once
items: Advance reservation rules allocate initial visits per specialty restaurant, but guests can frequently dine again.
Longer voyages (18+ days) officially provide multiple advance reservations per venue for eligible suites.
Onboard cancellations occur daily—visit the maître d' desk upon boarding to place your name on the waitlist.
Be flexible with dining times: tables at 6:00 PM or after 8:30 PM frequently open up during the voyage.
Notify the restaurant manager if celebrating an anniversary, milestone, or special birthday onboard.

cards.title: In-Suite Specialty Dining for Suite Guests
items: Suite guests (Penthouse, Oceania, Vista, Owner's Suites) enjoy exclusive specialty dining privileges in their accommodation.
Order appetizers, entrées, and desserts directly from Toscana, Jacques, Polo Grill, or Red Ginger menus.
Dedicated 24-hour butlers serve your meal course by course at your suite's formal dining table or private teak veranda.
Perfect for evenings after demanding shore excursions, quiet romantic dinners, or sunset ocean view dining.
Specialty in-suite dining is an exclusive suite privilege with zero additional delivery or service charges.

expertTips.title: 10 Expert Tips to Maximize Oceania Specialty Dining
expertTips.subtitle: INSIDER STRATEGIES FROM OUR CERTIFIED CRUISE ADVISORS

items.title: Match Ship to Cuisine
items.description: If Jacques French bistro or Red Ginger Asian is essential, choose Allura, Vista, Marina, or Riviera over smaller R-Class vessels.

items.title: Pay in Full Early
items.description: Your specialty dining reservation window will not open until your cruise is paid in full. Clear your balance early.

items.title: Set a Calendar Reminder
items.description: Log into Oceania My Account the exact morning your category window opens (75 days for Penthouse, 60 for Concierge, 45 for Veranda).

items.title: Stagger Your Specialty Dates
items.description: Space your specialty restaurant visits across your voyage so you have gourmet highlights to look forward to throughout the cruise.

items.title: Mix with the Grand Dining Room
items.description: Do not overlook The Grand Dining Room. Its menus change every evening with Jacques Pépin signatures and destination dishes.

items.title: Visit Polo Grill on Embarkation
items.description: Head to Polo Grill between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM (Suites/Concierge) or 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM to request second visits or time adjustments.

items.title: Leverage Butler In-Suite Meals
items.description: Suite guests can order course-by-course specialty meals delivered directly to their suite dining table or private balcony.

items.title: Budget for La Reserve Separately
items.description: If you wish to experience the Dom Pérignon or Wine Spectator dinner, reserve early and budget for the sommelier surcharge.

items.title: Be Flexible with Dining Times
items.description: Tables for two at 6:30 PM fill fast. Consider dining at 8:00 PM or 8:30 PM for quieter service and easier reservation access.

items.title: Confirm Beverage Terms
items.description: Check whether your Your World Included package covers wine and beer at dinner, or if you prefer an upgraded premium beverage package.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Specialty Dining
faqs.subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT COSTS, INCLUSIONS & BOOKING RULES

questions.question: Is specialty dining included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular specialty restaurant dining is included in the cruise fare. Guests can dine at available venues such as Polo Grill, Toscana, Jacques, and Red Ginger without paying a separate standard cover charge.

questions.question: Are all Oceania specialty restaurants free?
questions.answer: Regular dining at Oceania's signature specialty restaurants is included. However, exclusive culinary experiences such as La Reserve wine-pairing dinners and private dining at Privée carry additional charges.

questions.question: Do you pay extra for Polo Grill on Oceania?
questions.answer: No. Regular dining at Polo Grill is included in the cruise fare on all ships where the steakhouse is available.

questions.question: Is Toscana included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular dining at Toscana Italian restaurant is completely included in the cruise fare on ships that feature the venue.

questions.question: Is Jacques restaurant included on Oceania?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular dining at Jacques French bistro is included on ships where the restaurant operates (Marina, Riviera, Vista, and Allura).

questions.question: Is Red Ginger included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Regular dining at Red Ginger contemporary Asian restaurant is included on ships where it operates (Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, and Sirena).

questions.question: Is La Reserve included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: No. La Reserve wine-pairing dinners and culinary degustations (such as the Dom Pérignon Experience) carry an additional surcharge and require advance reservations.

questions.question: Is Privée included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: No. Privée is an exclusive private dining venue for up to 10 guests. A room reservation surcharge applies on ships where it is available.

questions.question: Do you need reservations for Oceania specialty restaurants?
questions.answer: Yes. Reservations are required at all specialty restaurants. The Grand Dining Room and casual venues (Terrace Café, Waves Grill, Aquamar Kitchen) do not require reservations.

questions.question: How many specialty dining reservations can I make on Oceania?
questions.answer: The published advance allowance allows 1 reservation at each specialty restaurant for standard voyages. Longer voyages (18+ days) and higher suite categories receive up to 2 or 3 advance reservations per venue.

questions.question: Can you make specialty dining reservations before sailing?
questions.answer: Yes. Advance reservations open online through Oceania's My Account portal once the applicable booking window opens and the cruise has been paid in full.

questions.question: When can Veranda guests book specialty dining?
questions.answer: Concierge Level Veranda guests can book from 60 days before sailing, and standard Veranda/Ocean View/Inside guests can book from 45 days before sailing, closing 7 days prior to departure.

questions.question: Can I book specialty dining once onboard?
questions.answer: Yes. Guests can request additional reservations or adjust times at the dining reservations desk onboard, subject to remaining nightly capacity.

questions.question: Can I visit the same specialty restaurant more than once?
questions.answer: Yes. While advance booking rules limit initial reservations, guests can book second visits onboard based on cancellations and remaining table availability.

questions.question: Does Oceania offer specialty dining for suite guests in their rooms?
questions.answer: Yes. Suite guests (Penthouse, Oceania, Vista, and Owner's Suites) can order from specialty restaurant menus for full course-by-course in-suite dining served by a dedicated butler.

questions.question: Does every Oceania ship have the same specialty restaurants?
questions.answer: No. Larger ships (Allura, Vista, Marina, Riviera) feature four signature specialty venues. Smaller R-Class ships (Nautica, Insignia, Sirena) feature two specialty restaurants.

questions.question: Is wine included at Oceania specialty restaurants?
questions.answer: Selected house wine and beer by the glass are included during restaurant lunch and dinner hours when that option is selected under Your World Included. Premium cellar wines carry extra charges.

questions.question: Are drinks included with specialty dining?
questions.answer: Not every alcoholic drink is included. Beverage inclusions depend on your fare package. Top-shelf cocktails, reserve spirits, and vintage Champagnes carry additional charges.

questions.question: Is room service included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Complimentary 24-hour in-room dining is provided to all guests, with expanded Grand Dining Room menus for Concierge Level and specialty dining for suite guests.

questions.question: Is Oceania specialty dining worth it?
questions.answer: Yes. Including high-caliber steakhouses, Italian, French, and Asian dining without cover charges makes Oceania one of the strongest value propositions in premium and luxury cruising.
